Unordered list produces List and ListItem nodes

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Items:</p><ul><li>Alpha</li><li>Beta</li><li>Gamma</li></ul>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(include_document_structure: true))
puts result.content.inspect
puts result.document.nodes.inspect
```
